subject: Medford Recreation Adaptive Sports Programs
overview: Medford Recreation Program Manager Kate Quinn joined hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan to discuss the city's adaptive sports offerings, inclusion request process, and facility accessibility. Quinn detailed volunteer recruitment challenges, highlighted popular programs like adaptive swimming and kickball, and explained how residents can sign up or request accommodations.

items.title: Introduction and Favorite Local Restaurants
items.summary: Hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan introduced Kate Quinn, Program Manager for Medford Recreation, who shared her favorite local eateries.

items.title: Overview of Adaptive Programs and Accommodations
items.summary: Kate Quinn explained Medford Recreation's inclusion request process and described how adaptive programs help participants transition into non-adaptive community sports.

items.title: Volunteer Needs and Recruitment
items.summary: Quinn identified volunteer shortages as the primary obstacle to increasing program capacity and described efforts to recruit local students and specialists.

items.title: Facility Accessibility and Community Equity
items.summary: The discussion addressed city accessibility improvements, highlighting affordable swim lessons at Tufts Pool and adaptive ice sleds at Lakhani Rink.

items.title: Popular Adaptive Sports Offerings
items.summary: Quinn highlighted high-demand programs including adaptive swim lessons and inclusive neighborhood kickball at Carr Park.

items.title: Program Registration and Volunteer Sign-Up
items.summary: Quinn outlined how participants can request accommodations and how community members can register to volunteer on the Medford Recreation website.
